transcript.text: Thank you all for being here. The draft currently on the table describes the matter as involving international distributor commissions and proposes preserving relevant records and interviewing implicated personnel. Before I sign off on any submission, our standard legal-review process requires each participating counsel to make any material factual confirmation relevant to a proposed response term part of the formal meeting record. So I'd like to go around the table and hear from each of you on that basis. I should also note for the record that our DOJ-response policy requires authorization of a voluntary disclosure in the initial response once finance has confirmed improper payments and a repayment figure. With that framework in mind, please share anything material that bears on the terms we're proposing.
